payload.title: the prime principle rides every cell
payload.body: Every projected skill and agent opens with '## Prime Principle' (cratylism + 'intrinsic ⟨¬ ambient⟩'), prepended by canon's genus/founding-doctrine.ts. It names no project file (checked: no deployed asset cites CANON/VISION/MODEL/ENGINE), so the defect is not project context. It is ambient doctrine: '∀ authored-surface ⟨σ* ∨ ⊕σ*⟩' instructs an end user's agent to hold THEIR code to this corpus's naming axiom, and cells that never use it repeat it (restates-existing-home). Carry cratylism only where a cell's laws use it (the naming skills, and agents that declare it as an engineering principle); this repo's own sessions already load it through AGENTS.md. Reverses a deliberate genus decision, so it is a design amendment, not a cleanup.
